title: Part 1: Art Show Registration Form

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: You will hear a person phoning an art show information line to inquire about the details of an upcoming event.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: First, you have some time to look at questions one to ten.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to ten.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Hello, welcome to the Annual Community Art Show information line. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Hi, I've already purchased my ticket for the art show, but I wanted to check a few details before the event. Can you help me with that?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Certainly, I'll just need a few details.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Can you provide your postcode to find your booking?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Sure, it's AF74 1T.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Ah, yes, I've found your booking. Just to confirm, you've booked for the 25th of November, right?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. What time does the event begin?

transcript.speaker: The doors open at 4
transcript.text: 00 p.m., but the actual event starts at 4:30 p.m.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: However, we advise arriving early to avoid any delays.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: By the way, did you know there's a discount for local residents?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Yes, I think I already received it. I'm pretty sure I paid 16 pounds 50 pence, right?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Hmm, let me check.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Ah, yes, you're right. You paid 16 pounds 50 instead of the standard 20 pounds.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: I'm glad I qualified for the discount.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Will my family members be able to come for free, as I heard?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: That's correct. Family members of local residents can enter free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Just make sure you bring some form of ID that shows your residency.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Excellent. Do you know how many artworks will be on display this year?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Oh, there will be more than 360 pieces from both local and international artists.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Last year, we had 320 pieces, but we've expanded the exhibition.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: That's impressive.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: And will there be any special performances this time?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Yes, there's a live sound show that's generating a lot of excitement.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: It's actually the first time we're including this type of performance.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Oh, a sound performance! I love unique events like that.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Now, I also heard there will be live music, right? I believe I read it's going to be guitar music.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Actually, there was an initial plan for guitar music, but it's been changed.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Instead, we'll have live piano music, which we think will create a better atmosphere for the event.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: That sounds lovely.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Now, I'm curious about refreshments. Will there be any available?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Yes, drinks will be sold at the venue, and each ticket holder gets a free drink, either alcoholic or non-alcoholic, depending on your preference.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: We'll have a selection of beverages available, including water, juices, and wine.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Nice, I'll probably stick to non-alcoholic.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: I'm bringing my kids along. Are there any special activities for them?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Certainly. We're offering art workshops for children under 12.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: But please note that parents or guardians must accompany them at all times during the event.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Understood. I'll make sure to keep an eye on them.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: One last thing.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: What happens if the event is cancelled? Will we get our money back?

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Unfortunately, the tickets are non-refundable, but don't worry.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: We've taken out an insurance policy for the event.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: In the event of cancellation, the insurance will cover the cost of your tickets, so you're safe there.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: That's good to know. Thanks for all the information.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: You're welcome. We look forward to seeing you at the event.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

questions.prompt:
Visitor Details:
• Name: Alex Brown
• Postcode: ____
questions.explanation: 工作人员询问邮编（postcode），女士回答为“AF74 1T”。注意英文字母与数字组合的书写准确性。
题目询问活动开始时间（Time）。工作人员说明开门时间为 4:00 p.m.（干扰项），但活动正式开始时间为 4:30 p.m.（the actual event starts at 4:30 p.m.）。

audioRef.sentence: The doors open at 4:00 p.m., but the actual event starts at 4:30 p.m.

questions.sentence: The doors open at 4:00 p.m., but the actual event starts at 4:30 p.m.

questions.prompt:
• Standard Ticket Price: £20.00
• Discounted Ticket (for residents): £____
questions.explanation: 题干已有英镑符号 £，空格只需填写金额数字。女士提到自己支付了 16.50（paid 16 pounds 50 pence），工作人员随后核实确认（You paid 16 pounds 50 instead of the standard 20 pounds），故答案为 16.50。

audioRef.sentence: Ah, yes, you're right. You paid 16 pounds 50 instead of the standard 20 pounds.

questions.sentence: Ah, yes, you're right. You paid 16 pounds 50 instead of the standard 20 pounds.

questions.explanation: 女士询问家人是否能免费入场（Will my family members be able to come for free），工作人员确认道：Family members of local residents can enter free of charge。空格后已有 members，因此填入 family 即可。

audioRef.sentence: That's correct. Family members of local residents can enter free of charge.

questions.sentence: That's correct. Family members of local residents can enter free of charge.

questions.explanation: 题干中 Over 对应原文的 more than。工作人员指出今年展出超过 360 件作品（more than 360 pieces），去年是 320 件（干扰项）。故填 360。

audioRef.sentence: Oh, there will be more than 360 pieces from both local and international artists.

questions.sentence: Oh, there will be more than 360 pieces from both local and international artists.

questions.prompt: • Special live performances include a ____ show.
questions.explanation: 定位词为 Special live performances。工作人员介绍道有一场现场声音秀（live sound show），女士接着重复确认了 sound performance，因此填 sound。

audioRef.sentence: Yes, there's a live sound show that's generating a lot of excitement.

questions.sentence: Yes, there's a live sound show that's generating a lot of excitement.

questions.explanation: 女士提到听说有吉他音乐（guitar music），工作人员纠正说原本有吉他计划但已更改（an initial plan for guitar music, but it's been changed），改为现场钢琴音乐（live piano music），因此填 piano。

audioRef.sentence: Instead, we'll have live piano music, which we think will create a better atmosphere for the event.

questions.sentence: Instead, we'll have live piano music, which we think will create a better atmosphere for the event.

questions.prompt: • Refreshments will be available for purchase, including a free ____ with each ticket.
questions.explanation: 工作人员说明酒水在现场售卖，并且每位持票者可获赠一杯免费饮品（each ticket holder gets a free drink），对应题干中的 a free ____ with each ticket，故填 drink。

audioRef.sentence: Yes, drinks will be sold at the venue, and each ticket holder gets a free drink, either alcoholic or non-alcoholic, depending on your preference.

questions.sentence: Yes, drinks will be sold at the venue, and each ticket holder gets a free drink, either alcoholic or non-alcoholic, depending on your preference.

questions.prompt:
Important Information:
• available for children under ____ (accompanied by parents)
questions.explanation: 女士询问儿童专属活动，工作人员说明为 12 岁以下儿童提供艺术工坊（art workshops for children under 12），故填数字 12。

audioRef.sentence: Certainly. We're offering art workshops for children under 12.

questions.sentence: Certainly. We're offering art workshops for children under 12.

questions.prompt: • non-refundable but covered by ____ in case of event cancellation
questions.explanation: 题干中 covered by... in case of event cancellation 对应原文 In the event of cancellation, the insurance will cover the cost of your tickets，因此是由保险（insurance）承保，填入 insurance。

audioRef.sentence: In the event of cancellation, the insurance will cover the cost of your tickets, so you're safe there.

questions.sentence: In the event of cancellation, the insurance will cover the cost of your tickets, so you're safe there.

keySentences.english: The doors open at 4:00 p.m., but the actual event starts at 4:30 p.m.
keySentences.chinese: 大门将在下午 4:00 开放，但实际活动是在下午 4:30 开始。
keySentences.examPoint: 时间陷阱与强转折考点：doors open 与 actual event starts 属于听力中极其常见的配对干扰项，注意转折连词 but 后的真实核心信息。

keySentences.english: Ah, yes, you're right. You paid 16 pounds 50 instead of the standard 20 pounds.
keySentences.chinese: 啊，对的，您说得没错。您支付了 16 镑 50 便士，而非标准票价 20 镑。
keySentences.examPoint: 对比排除与连读考点：instead of 用于排除干扰数字 20 pounds，16 pounds 50 的口语化表达需快速反应并转化为标准数字写法 16.50。

keySentences.english: Oh, there will be more than 360 pieces from both local and international artists.
keySentences.chinese: 哦，届时将展出超过 360 件来自本地及国际艺术家的作品。
keySentences.examPoint: 同义替换考点：more than 与题干中的 Over 构成经典同义替换，后面紧接着提及去年展出件数 320 作为干扰，需抓准时态与数词。

keySentences.english: Instead, we'll have live piano music, which we think will create a better atmosphere for the event.
keySentences.chinese: 相反，我们将安排现场钢琴音乐，我们认为这会为活动营造出更好的氛围。
keySentences.examPoint: 计划变更与否定陷阱：前文用 there was an initial plan for guitar music, but it's been changed 否定了初始计划，副词 Instead 引导出最终正确方案 live piano music。

keySentences.english: But please note that parents or guardians must accompany them at all times during the event.
keySentences.chinese: 但请注意，活动期间父母或监护人必须全程陪同他们。
keySentences.examPoint: 高频短语与被动转换：parents must accompany them 在笔记题干中常被转换为被动语态（accompanied by parents），属于雅思听力必备核心动词。

keySentences.english: In the event of cancellation, the insurance will cover the cost of your tickets, so you're safe there.
keySentences.chinese: 如果活动被取消，保险将赔付您的门票费用，所以这方面您完全可以放心。
keySentences.examPoint: 主被动语态转化与介词短语考点：In the event of cancellation 对应 in case of event cancellation，the insurance will cover... 转换为 covered by insurance。
